findings.summary: The interface does not respond to the user color-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: The CSS probe found no color-scheme, prefers-color-scheme or light-dark() support; the computed root color-scheme is normal and the dark-emulated capture is unchanged.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare supported color schemes and express surfaces with preference-aware tokens.

findings.summary: Continuous animation remains active under reduced motion.
findings.evidence: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, four animations were still running, including infinite 8s, 10s and 1.5s animations; no reduced-motion rule was found.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a reduced-motion media query that removes non-essential animation and stops auto-repeating decorative effects.

findings.summary: Route changes have no transition continuity.
findings.evidence: The CSS probe found no view-transition usage across an MPA whose primary task moves among listing, search and detail routes.
findings.suggestedFix: Use same-origin cross-document View Transitions with a reduced-motion fallback for listing-to-detail navigation.

findings.summary: Long listings provide no scroll-state guidance.
findings.evidence: The homepage is about 4600px tall on mobile, while the CSS probe found no scroll-state, progress or scroll-position-aware treatment.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a lightweight scroll-position cue or responsive sticky chrome only where it helps orientation.

findings.summary: Rich controls and overlays are not built from semantic platform primitives.
findings.evidence: The platform probe found zero dialog, popover and details elements; filtering and the full-viewport age-verification state are custom/third-party UI.
findings.suggestedFix: Use dialog for required modal flows and details/popover for disclosure and transient controls, preserving the legally required age gate.

findings.summary: Advertising is visually mixed into primary navigation and content chrome.
findings.evidence: The crawler capture shows outbound promotional links such as “AI Jerk Off” and ThePornDude styled beside Tags, Login and Signup, competing with the content task.
findings.suggestedFix: Clearly label and visually separate advertising, and reduce promotional chrome around search and content discovery.

findings.summary: Components adapt only at the viewport level.
findings.evidence: The responsive probe found no @container/container-type usage across reused listing and filter components, although narrow layout itself had no overflow.
findings.suggestedFix: Add container queries where card/filter components appear in multiple available widths.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is not visibly indicated on core controls.
findings.evidence: A scripted focus walk found outline:none and no focus box shadow on menu, search and many navigation controls; several icon buttons also had no text.
findings.suggestedFix: Add strong :focus-visible styles and accessible names while retaining at least 24 by 24 CSS pixel targets.

findings.summary: Resource delivery includes avoidable blocking and weakly optimised assets.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 63 requests and 837,392 transferred bytes. A synchronous parser-inserted AgeVerif script is in the head, and the images audit found 20 missing dimensions and 35 images without srcset.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer non-critical scripts where safe, reserve image space, and deliver responsive image candidates with explicit dimensions.

findings.summary: Third-party JavaScript dominates a substantial part of the initial load.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 20 script requests and 431,807 script bytes; Google Tag Manager alone transferred 169,277 bytes, and third parties transferred 355,031 bytes overall.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove low-value vendors, load advertising and analytics after consent/intent, and conditionally load page-specific code.

findings.summary: Core controls and embedded advertising lack accessible names.
findings.evidence: axe found critical button-name failures for the burger and search buttons, serious frame-title failures for two iframes, a critical unlabeled selector, and three unnamed links.
findings.suggestedFix: Add programmatic names to icon buttons and links, labels to controls, and descriptive titles to iframes.

findings.summary: Text and controls fail minimum color contrast.
findings.evidence: axe reported six serious color-contrast failures with another 44 nodes requiring review, including buttons, body copy and header text.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust foreground/background tokens to meet WCAG AA in default and interaction states.

findings.summary: The homepage lacks a strong semantic structure and visible focus order.
findings.evidence: Rendered DOM has no h1, main or nav landmark, and the focus probe shows outlines removed from the first core controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a single descriptive h1, main/nav landmarks, logical source order, and visible :focus-visible styling.

findings.summary: Video has no caption or equivalent track.
findings.evidence: The representative detail page contains a video element with zero track elements; several footer links also measured only 17px high.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide captions or an equivalent transcript for video and enlarge undersized interactive targets.

findings.summary: Image markup and delivery are not consistently sound.
findings.evidence: The images audit found 20 images without width/height, 19 oversized images, 20 legacy-format images and no modern-format images among 55 inspected images.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit width and height, responsive srcset/sizes, and AVIF/WebP variants while preserving alt text.

findings.summary: Standard sitemap discovery is inconsistent.
findings.evidence: /sitemap.xml returned 404 while a nonstandard /sitemap/ endpoint returned XML; robots.txt does not advertise that endpoint. Canonicals and successful public pages otherwise worked.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve or redirect /sitemap.xml and declare the sitemap URL in robots.txt.

findings.summary: Video pages lack social share metadata.
findings.evidence: The detail page has useful VideoObject JSON-LD but zero Open Graph tags, so shared previews cannot reliably represent its title, thumbnail and canonical URL.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate Open Graph and Twitter Card metadata derived from the visible VideoObject fields.

findings.summary: Cookie and transport defenses are incomplete.
findings.evidence: Ten of 12 observed cookies lacked Secure; several use SameSite=None. HSTS is absent and CSP only upgrades insecure requests rather than restricting script sources.
findings.suggestedFix: Mark all HTTPS cookies Secure, use the strictest viable SameSite policy, deploy HSTS, and replace the upgrade-only CSP with an allowlist-based policy.

findings.summary: The page sends a large, privacy-sensitive third-party footprint before user intent.
findings.evidence: Tracker evidence found 14 third-party origins including Google Analytics; HAR counted 26 third-party requests and 355,031 bytes. Request URLs expose detailed device, plugin, canvas, locale and graphics signals to ad domains.
findings.suggestedFix: Minimise vendors and fingerprinting parameters, gate non-essential analytics/ads behind meaningful consent or intent, and batch only necessary measurements.

findings.summary: Authentication is password-only and omits modern input semantics.
findings.evidence: The login page exposes email and password fields with no autocomplete tokens and no WebAuthn/PublicKeyCredential integration.
findings.suggestedFix: Add autocomplete=username and current-password immediately, then offer passkey authentication as a phishing-resistant option.

findings.summary: Several browser-enforced policies are missing.
findings.evidence: Headers include X-Frame-Options, nosniff and Referrer-Policy, but omit HSTS and Permissions-Policy; CSP contains only upgrade-insecure-requests.
findings.suggestedFix: Add HSTS, an explicit Permissions-Policy, and a restrictive CSP with frame-ancestors and Trusted Types where applicable.

findings.summary: Layout CSS is not prepared for bidirectional or translated content.
findings.evidence: The document correctly declares lang=en, but the CSS probe found no logical inline/block properties and the root has no explicit direction.
findings.suggestedFix: Retain the language declaration, add dir where content direction can vary, and replace physical left/right spacing and positioning with logical properties.

findings.summary: Outbound ads are presented like first-party navigation without clear disclosure.
findings.evidence: The rendered crawler view places promotional outbound destinations among Tags, Login and Signup, while ad iframes are untitled and ad scripts come from opaque domains.
findings.suggestedFix: Label advertising explicitly, separate it from first-party navigation, and make destination and commercial intent clear before activation.

findings.summary: Sign-in fields do not support standard autofill semantics.
findings.evidence: The login probe found empty autocomplete values on both the email and password fields.
findings.suggestedFix: Use autocomplete=username and autocomplete=current-password, and support passkey conditional UI when added.

findings.summary: Listing imagery is oversized and lacks modern responsive delivery.
findings.evidence: Of 55 images, 19 were more than twice their display width, 35 lacked srcset, 20 used legacy formats and none used a modern format.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate appropriately sized AVIF/WebP candidates and responsive srcset/sizes; lazy-load truly below-fold images.

findings.summary: Third-party cost is disproportionate before content interaction.
findings.evidence: Third parties account for 355,031 of 837,392 transferred bytes and 26 requests, including analytics and multiple advertising/fingerprinting domains before a core task is attempted.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party budget, remove low-value vendors, and defer non-essential third-party work until consent or interaction.

taskList.title: Reduce and gate third-party advertising, tracking and fingerprinting
Repair keyboard, naming, landmark, contrast and caption accessibility
Harden cookies, CSP, HSTS and browser policies
Optimise responsive images and resource delivery
Modernise sign-in with autocomplete and passkeys
